08 / COMET FOUNDRY
FoundryGuidedTutorialUI.cs:261–270 / FoundryPlayableController.IsGuidedFacilityPlaced
private bool IsGuidedFacilityPlaced(FacilityInstance facility) { var size = facility.Definition.FootprintSize; for (int x = 0; x < size.x; x++) for (int y = 0; y < size.y; y++) { var tile = session.Comet.Grid.GetTile(facility.Anchor + new Vector2Int(x, y)); if (tile == null || tile.Occupant != CometTileOccupant.Facility || !tile.OccupantId.Equals(facility.Id)) return false; } return session.FacilityAt(facility.Anchor) == facility; }
설치 면적 전체의 점유 ID와 기준 좌표의 실제 시설 객체가 일치해야 완료다.

private static bool TryDamageTile(CometGrid grid, Vector2Int coordinate, int remaining) { var previous = grid.GetTile(coordinate).Terrain; grid.GetTile(coordinate).SetTerrain(CometTileTerrain.Void); if (ActiveTilesConnected(grid, remaining)) return true; grid.GetTile(coordinate).SetTerrain(previous); return false; }
